strategy.goal: traffic and visitor volume (broad reach), targeting US/Canada + keeping EU
strategy.core_insight: Head terms (tcp vs udp, java websocket tutorial) are owned by DA80+ giants (MDN, Cloudflare, GeeksforGeeks, Baeldung, DZone, dev.to, Medium, GitHub). A young site cannot win those. The winnable lane is LONG-TAIL, code-first, runnable-example queries where small niche blogs still rank (ops.tips, hyr.mn, xojoc.pw all rank for 'tcp udp echo server go example'). Code Beneath's existing strength (opinionated, runnable code, GitHub-linked) is exactly what wins these.
strategy.how_we_beat_competitors: Every article must be MORE complete than the current top-3 result for its keyword: full runnable code (not fragments), edge cases and common errors, a comparison table where relevant, and a short FAQ. That depth + specificity is how we outrank bigger domains on long-tail.
strategy.publish_model: fully automatic with an AI self-QA gate before publish; fail -> one auto-repair -> still fail -> _needs-review/ quarantine, never published
hard_rules: code must be runnable and correct
